name: Can drywall finishing address imperfections from previous installations or repairs?

mainEntity.name: Can drywall finishing address imperfections from previous installations or repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, professional drywall finishing can effectively address and conceal many imperfections from previous installations or repairs. This often involves applying additional layers of joint compound, feathering them out, and careful sanding to blend the repair seamlessly with the surrounding wall. For significant damage, minor patches may be needed before the finishing process begins to ensure a durable and aesthetically pleasing result. The goal is to create a uniform surface ready for new paint or texture.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional drywall finishing can cover and blend imperfections from prior work or repairs, often requiring extra compound and careful sanding.
